name: What is the process for replacing my front door?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing my front door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with a consultation to discuss your needs, style preferences, and budget. We'll help you select the right door material and design. Next, detailed measurements are taken to ensure a perfect fit. Once the new door arrives, our team will remove your old door and frame, prepare the opening, install the new pre-hung door unit, ensure it's plumb and level, and then complete all necessary trim work and sealing. Finally, we conduct a walkthrough with you to ensure satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, door selection, precise measurements, old door removal, new door installation, and finishing touches.
